meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你要重构代码时，它会先分析目标文件和相关代码，评估测试覆盖，制定详细计划，再一步步修改并随时运行测试检查，确保不破坏现有功能，最后输出变更总结。
howto.when: 当你说出“refactor”“cleanup”“simplify”等关键词，或用 /refactor 命令提出重构请求时触发；若目标含糊，它会先询问具体改进方向。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 重构一下，用安全策略。
say.note: 它会先分析这个文件再动手。

say.text: 提取登录校验的逻辑到独立模块。
say.note: 它会先确认目标再开始。

say.text: 简化项目里所有用废弃 API 的函数。
say.note: 范围较大时会先评估风险。

howto.what_en: It analyzes the target code and tests, creates a plan, refactors step by step with verification, then summarizes changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "refactor", "cleanup", "simplify", or when you request a refactor via /refactor. If the goal is vague, it asks for specifics.

say_en.text: Extract login validation logic into a separate module.
Simplify all functions using deprecated APIs in the project.
say_en.note: It assesses risk for larger scope.
